name: 2CR5

dimensions.note: Width is the long side of the two-lobed top view. The datasheet also shows a 16.4 mm maximum and 15.6 mm minimum dimension on the lobe outline.

geometry.note: Two cylindrical cells side by side in one keyed wrap. Both terminals sit on one end face as two small square contacts, recessed in the wrap, marked - and +, per the datasheet drawing. Wikipedia gives a 16 mm center-to-center terminal spacing.

capacity_mah.conditions: 200 ohm continuous, 21 °C; the datasheet prints the end point as 2.0 V, while its service table reads 58 hours to 4.0 V

interchange.note: The CR-P2 is a similar 6 V pack with a different footprint and contact layout, and the keyed shapes do not fit each other.

safety: Lithium photo batteries are single-use and are not designed to be recharged; charging can cause venting, fire or rupture.
Do not short-circuit, crush, heat or disassemble. The battery contains a positive temperature coefficient (PTC) device to limit short-circuit current, but it does not make the battery safe to abuse.
Replace all batteries in a device at the same time and do not mix them with used batteries or other types.
notes: The wrap is keyed so it fits a compartment in one orientation only.
